answer: One concrete mechanism: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because glacier only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, vine is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any hollow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
